measurement_scope: Accuracy matches exact question IDs, question text and option ordering. Final tokens/QA seconds exclude navigation/extraction/planning/filtering/review. P reader_total_seconds includes review. Successful processing preserves reused dependencies once; migration interrupted reservations are budget debt, not measured runtime. O paired processing covers both arms jointly and excludes N source retrieval. Shared GPU timings are not controlled speedups. Known demos and mixed historical P versions remain separately identified.
